rules.formula: net EST = rate x 0.87 - (diesel/gal / 8.0 mpg + $0.034/mi DEF) x (loaded + empty miles). Diesel is the EIA on-highway price for the origin state's PADD, week of 2026-11-23. Fallback is $1.14/loaded mi + $0.30/empty mi if no price is on file.
rules.per_hour_formula: $/hr EST = net EST / hours. Hours = (loaded mi + deadhead mi) / 50 mph + 2 h load/unload per load.
rules.net_per_mile_formula: Net $/mi EST = net EST / (loaded mi + empty miles).
rules.gross_per_mile_formula: Gross $/mi = posted rate / (loaded mi + empty miles). Rate/mi is posted rate / loaded miles only.
rules.days_formula: Trip days = (loaded mi + empty miles) / 550 mi/day + 2 h load/unload per load, rounded up to the next half day. If the pickup-to-drop window (or a wait between combo legs) is longer, that window is used.
rules.quality_bar: Single load >= $500 net EST, or >= $300 for a same-day run under 250 total miles. A chain needs >= $1,000 total with no losing leg. Length over 40 ft, width over 8.5 ft, or weight over 15,300 lb is an automatic PASS. Cargo up to 12,500 lb is OK; 12,501-15,300 lb is MAYBE (scale check, load centered just ahead of trailer axles). Ram GVWR 14,000 lb binds (CAT empty 10,940 lb on the truck). No overhang. Tarp-required, F+T, and FT loads are a fit; the rig has tarps and straps.
rules.combo_bar: A 2- or 3-load combo needs >= $1,000 total net EST, must beat the best single load in it by at least $200, and no leg may lose money. Shared-deck combos keep combined weight <= 15,300 lb (12,501-15,300 lb is MAYBE) and combined length <= 40 ft for whatever is on the deck at the same time. Extra pickups must stay within about 100 mi of detour and extra drops within about 150 mi. Sequential chains deliver one load, then pick up the next within about 100 mi of the drop. Windows are checked at 550 mi/day. Route miles use the posted trip when the lane matches, otherwise haversine x 1.2. Unknown weight or length is flagged.
